description: Compute the balanced offset contributed by a divider on one side of a cell, derived from the divider's total size. Inputs are: which side of the cell the offset is for (top, bottom, start, or end); the divider size in pixels; the span count of the line; the zero-based span index of the cell; and whether the side dividers (the outer dividers at the very start and end of each line) are visible. The size is distributed across the cells of a line so the cells stay visually balanced; the leading sides (top/start) and trailing sides (bottom/end) receive complementary shares depending on the cell's span index. When a share would land exactly on a half pixel, it is rounded so the two complementary offsets still sum to the full size: the leading side takes the floor and the trailing side takes the ceiling. The result is a single non-negative integer pixel value.
